title: Immutable vendor index and checksum-aware delta applier for air-gapped bundles
author: Lena Park
release_notes: Adds an immutable vendor index (content-addressed, signed) and a checksum-aware delta applier to enable smaller, atomic airgap updates; validation tooling (`airgap-verify`) included; Terraform and Helm references updated to consume index metadata.
description: Summary: Introduces an immutable vendor index (vendor-index.json) that is content-addressed and GPG-signed, plus a checksum-aware delta applier that can apply smaller deltas to on-prem runtime bundles deterministically. This reduces the size of upgrade payloads for air-gapped sites and provides stronger integrity guarantees. Motivation and context: Customers running Private (air-gapped) deployments repeatedly asked for smaller upgrade payloads and a deterministic validation step so they can attest vendor artifacts before applying updates (ENG-4823). Current delta snapshots are sequence-based and can produce non-deterministic ordering in the on-disk layout, which complicates validation and reproducible rollbacks. This PR implements a content-addressable index and a patch applier that uses checksums to match and apply file-level deltas securely. Design highlights: 1) vendor-index.json - a top-level immutable index that lists artifacts by content-hash (sha256), size, origin (OCI tar manifest or distro package), and an optional public key fingerprint for signature verification. Each index is signed with the release key; the installer verifies the signature before any operation. 2) checksum-aware delta applier - given a base bundle and an index+delta package, the applier validates checksums of the base files, downloads/apply only the changed blobs, validates resulting checksums against the target index, and performs an atomic swap of the runtime bundle directory. 3) deterministic ordering - tarball/OCI layer creation and extraction are ordered by hash to ensure identical on-disk layouts across hosts. 4) integration hooks - the Terraform module now exposes a vendor_index_url and vetting flags; Helm chart values expose index checksums for preflight checks; CLI tooling (installer/cmd/airgap-verify and installer/cmd/delta-apply) is added for operators. Backwards compatibility: The installer supports legacy snapshot bundles. When a vendor-index is present, the new path is preferred; otherwise we fall back to legacy behaviour with a deprecation warning. Checklist (PR scope): - [x] Generate vendor-index schema and signer/verifier code - [x] Implement delta applier with checksum validation and atomic apply - [x] Add CLI `airgap-verify` and `delta-apply` commands - [x] Update Terraform module to accept vendor_index_url and preflight options - [x] Update Helm chart values and add pre-install hook to validate index signature - [x] Add integration tests for index validation and delta application - [x] Add docs: docs/airgap-vendor-index.md Commit summary: - Commit 1: add vendor-index schema, producer tooling and tests - Commit 2: implement immutable-index verifier and GPG signing utilities - Commit 3: delta applier core logic + atomic swap integration tests - Commit 4: CLI commands and user-facing messages - Commit 5: terraform and helm integration, docs, and changelog notes Files changed (high-level): - installer/pkg/vendoring/index.go (new) - installer/pkg/vendoring/producer.go (new) - installer/pkg/vendoring/applier.go (mod + tests) - installer/cmd/airgap-verify/main.go (new) - installer/cmd/delta-apply/main.go (new) - terraform/modules/registry/main.tf (mod) - helm/redwood-private/values.yaml (mod) - docs/airgap-vendor-index.md (new) - scripts/test/integration/airgap-index.sh (new) Small snippet (index schema example): {"version":"1","entries":[{"path":"images/redwood-runtime-1.2.0.tar","sha256":"<hex>","size":12345678,"type":"oci","origin":"internal-release"}]} Review thread (high level): - Diego Morales: "Please make sure we enforce deterministic ordering when creating the tar layers. Without that we won't be able to reproduce checksums across hosts." - Lena Park: "Agreed — implemented ordering by sorting entries by sha256 before tar generation. Added integration test 'airgap-index/reproducible-layout' to validate this." - Anika Shah: "Signature verification looks good but can we allow an operator-provided key for air-gapped environments?" - Lena Park: "Added a --trusted-key-file flag to airgap-verify and an optional terraform var trusted_key_pem. If not provided we verify against the embedded release key (existing behavior)." - Tom Bender: "Small nit: applier logs should avoid leaking full paths in verbose logs. Also add progress metrics to help SRE." - Lena Park: "Removed absolute paths from logs and added prometheus counters for applied_blobs_total and applied_bytes_total." CI and testing: - Initial CI run failed on integration job 'airgap-integ/validate-index' due to a race in the integration test harness (file watcher). Root cause: the test assumed the on-disk notification trigger delivered in <1s. Fix: added explicit sync barrier and increased timeouts in scripts/test/integration/airgap-index.sh. - Rerun CI: all checks passed (unit, lint, integration). CI status: pass. Performance and safety notes: - Delta applier applies blobs concurrently but bounds concurrency to maintain predictable memory usage; default concurrency tunable via --apply-parallelism. - On mismatch during apply, the applier aborts and leaves a preserved snapshot of the pre-update bundle for rollback. - Added a fast-path for full-OCI-image replacements when checksums show >70% churn. Docs and operator guidance: - docs/airgap-vendor-index.md includes: index schema, signing flow, terraform/helm examples, recommended rollback steps, and a short troubleshooting guide for signature or checksum failures. - Added a 'preflight' Terraform example that will fail early if signature or checksum doesn't match. Release/rollout plan: - Soft-rollout: enable verifier by default on new installs and opt-in for existing sites for 2 weeks. - After opt-in window, flip enforcement to required in the next minor release. Merge details: Squash-merged into main after approvals from Diego and Anika and green CI. Notes for release notes: see `release_notes` field. Follow-ups (future work): - Add delta-creation tooling in the release pipeline to produce signed delta artifacts automatically. - Add granular ACL metadata to index entries to support private registries and per-tenant allowlists.
